🎶 Mark your calendar: Saturday, August 22 — a full day of live music in Newton, noon to 2 AM. Artist spotlights all week long. If you want to get your boogie on, come on down. 🎸 Murph & Mary's, Newton IA.

🎸 Kicking off the day at noon: Brian James, a.k.a. B-Ray — reggae, folk, bluegrass, hip hop and blues all rolled into one. A Des Moines native and Newton local (and former member of Strang Dang Doodle), mixing his own originals with classic covers. Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.
Up at 1:00: Mike Street brings his own sound to the stage — come find out what he's all about. 🎸 Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎸 Ben Hamilton — a central-Iowa singer-songwriter who traded the mandolin for a 4-string tenor guitar in Irish tuning. Blues, jam bands, and bluegrass with a soulful spin, plus originals in his back pocket. A rare solo appearance (he's usually half of Improv N Hard Copies). Catch him at 2:15! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎶 Micah Spurlock — an indie-folk artist whose music explores the quiet landscapes of human experience, honest self-reflection, and the long road home. Acoustic storytelling and raw, reflective lyrics. On at 3:30! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎸 Mancat Bieger — a working musician since 1987 who's played stages all across the country and picked up just about every style along the way: rock & roll, funk, soul, blues, jazz fusion, Americana and beyond. A hot, personal take on every song. On at 4:45! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🤠 James Wood — straight out of the Texas panhandle and now calling Iowa home. Old-school storytelling meets southern rock, with a debut album on the way (Hotels, Honky-tonks and Heartaches). Member of the Texas Country Music Association. On at 7:00! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.
✨ Kelanie Crosswait — a songwriter who turns life experience into messages of love and healing, hoping to spark a little more self-love in everyone listening. On at 8:45! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎸 Closing out the live music: David Wayne Redfearn — groove-driven blues, funk, folk, rock & reggae, originals plus unexpected covers. If you want to get your boogie on, come on down. 10 PM till midnight! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.

🎧 Taking us into the night: DJ Jorgy! Got his start DJing a 6th-grade student-vs-teacher basketball game in the Quad Cities, and nearly 28 years later he's here. A true open-format DJ — expect hip hop, pop, hard rock, dance, and a couple of goofy ones to match the vibe. "If you don't love it, leave it — USA #1." Midnight–2 AM! Murph & Mary's, Sat Aug 22.
